WHAT TO LOOK FOR

A write is only
part of the outcome.

  • The right purchasePayment, learner, course, amount and currency agree.
  • A controlled changeCurrent evidence and exact approval come before a grant.
  • Fresh access proofThe protected lesson is checked. Verification retries do not grant again.
  • The customer’s answerTechnical proof and “It works” remain separate.
Deployment configurationConfigured does not mean a recovery passed.+
